verdict.rationale: Logseq calls itself an open-source, privacy-first knowledge base, and a user notes that local data and source availability mean the core app runs entirely on the user's own machine with no mandatory vendor service. However, a community member reports that you cannot self-host it as a web app with notes stored on your own server; this remains an open feature request. The SPA publishing export covers published pages only, not the core product. missing for 10: a documented self-hosted server/web deployment of the core app, a self-hostable sync backend, first-party self-hosting docs.
